narrative.overview: An editorial voice and practical forms share a flat reading surface. Rules separate decisions and examples; typography carries emphasis. This is the creator’s inferred direction under an offline controlled brief, rather than a human-approved brand identity.
keyCharacteristics: Forest ink, warm paper, pale fields.
Serif headings and direct sans-serif controls.
Flat divisions with readable local feedback.
dos: Do keep complete billing conditions with the decision.
Do label static media and provide access to its full-size local file.
Do keep the page flat and use typography before decoration.
donts: Don’t describe the creator’s inferred direction as human approved.
Don’t treat supplied editor illustrations as working product controls.
